questionEnglish: In the context of coordinate geometry, what do we call the horizontal axis and the vertical axis?
questionOdia: ସ୍ଥାନାଙ୍କ ଜ୍ୟାମିତିରେ, କ୍ଷିତିଜୀୟ ଅକ୍ଷ (horizontal axis) ଏବଂ ଉଲ୍ଲମ୍ବ ଅକ୍ଷକୁ (vertical axis) କ'ଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: ସ୍ଥାନାଙ୍କ ସମତଳରେ ଆଡ଼େଇ ଥିବା ରେଖାକୁ X-ଅକ୍ଷ ଏବଂ ଠିଆ ଥିବା ରେଖାକୁ Y-ଅକ୍ଷ କୁହାଯାଏ।

questionEnglish: What is the coordinate of the origin in a Cartesian coordinate system?

questionEnglish: What is the formula to find the distance between two points A(x1, y1) and B(x2, y2)?
